sentences.en: Sara and Kofi go to a club party.
sentences.zh: 萨拉和科菲去参加一个俱乐部聚会。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) and Kofi (a man of about thirty with dark skin, a shaved head, a short black beard and a light-blue shirt) walk into a bright room with balloons and many people.

sentences.en: The group has members from around the world.
sentences.zh: 这个团体的成员来自世界各地。
sentences.scene_prompt: A crowd of people of many different looks and skin colours chat and laugh together in the room.
sentences.draw_note: Shows a mixed group of people; that they come from many countries can only be guessed.

sentences.en: Anyone of any age or nationality can join.
sentences.zh: 任何年龄、任何国籍的人都可以加入。
sentences.scene_prompt: Children, young people and old people of different backgrounds stand together smiling and holding hands.
sentences.draw_note: Shows people of all ages and backgrounds together; 'can join' can't be shown.

sentences.en: Sara meets Grandma Rosa, a kind married lady.
sentences.zh: 萨拉认识了罗莎奶奶，一位和蔼的已婚女士。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) shakes hands with Grandma Rosa (an old woman with white hair in a bun, a purple shawl and a walking stick), who wears a gold wedding ring.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Sara meeting Grandma Rosa, a wedding ring on her hand; 'married' is only hinted.

sentences.en: Her husband, Grandpa Joe, is a funny Australian man.
sentences.zh: 她的丈夫乔爷爷是个风趣的澳大利亚人。
sentences.scene_prompt: Grandpa Joe (an old man, bald with a white beard, in a brown cardigan) tells a joke and everyone around him laughs, while Grandma Rosa (an old woman with white hair in a bun, a purple shawl and a walking stick) holds his arm.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Grandpa Joe making people laugh beside his wife; 'Australian' can't be shown.

sentences.en: Their adult daughter, Anna, is at the party too.
sentences.zh: 他们已成年的女儿安娜也在聚会上。
sentences.scene_prompt: Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan) waves and walks across the room toward Grandma Rosa (an old woman with white hair in a bun, a purple shawl and a walking stick) and Grandpa Joe (an old man, bald with a white beard, in a brown cardigan).

sentences.en: Sara finds Grandma Rosa's stories very interesting.
sentences.zh: 萨拉觉得罗莎奶奶讲的故事非常有意思。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) listens with wide, interested eyes while Grandma Rosa (an old woman with white hair in a bun, a purple shawl and a walking stick) tells a story.

sentences.en: Kofi has a good feeling about the club.
sentences.zh: 科菲对这个俱乐部感觉很好。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi (a man of about thirty with dark skin, a shaved head, a short black beard and a light-blue shirt) smiles happily and shakes hands with people at the party.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Kofi happy and friendly at the party; his feeling about the club is only implied.
